entities.summary: Peter Bastian was a Danish musician. He was born in Copenhagen and was educated in both theoretical physics and classical bassoon. He was a member of The Danish Wind Quintet and the Danish band Bazaar. In 1998 he was knighted in the Order of the Dannebrog. He is the author of two books published by Gyldendal, "Ind i Musikken" 1987 and "Mesterlære – en livsfortælling" 2011.
